annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and sharpness composition. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6400, incremented at intervals of 1600 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Sharpness composition," with a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^-3 to 10^0, with labeled tick intervals at each order of magnitude. There are two lines on the plot. The first line is blue, without markers, and solid in style. It starts at approximately 10^0 on the y-axis at the lowest training step and remains nearly constant across the x-axis. The second line is orange, without markers, and also solid. It begins near 10^0 at the start but quickly decreases, reaching about 10^-2 at a training step of 320, then fluctuates around this value with slight peaks at 10^-1 on the y-axis at the 3400 time step and declines throughout the remainder of the range, ending slightly higher than the initial sharper drop.
